Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite, sowing phase of wheat.
Reference image 1 is STYLE only: match its warm detailed pixel art, upper-left light, dark pixel outline, transparent isolation and tiny seed-on-soil composition. Replace its seed with ONE golden wheat grain, elongated with a single lengthwise crease.
CRITICAL COUNT: exactly ONE visible seed / planting unit, sitting alone in a very small pinch of dark cultivated earth. One seed will grow into one plant. No second seed anywhere. The little earth crumbs must be dark brown and clearly distinct from the single lighter seed.
Strict 2:1 isometric ground view, crisp hard pixel clusters, flat restrained earthy colours, no smooth gradients or blur. One compact readable silhouette. Seed partly pressed into the centre of the small soil pinch, visible enough to identify. Soil pinch no wider than twice the seed. No ground tile, no field, no diamond, no bag, no seed pile, no repeating dots, no rows, no sprouts, no roots, no leaves, no fruit, no plant, no label, no text, no scene or cast shadow.
Square PNG with genuine alpha transparency, keep all outside pixels transparent. Centre horizontally, place this tiny compact seed-and-soil subject toward lower centre of the canvas with generous transparent padding just like reference. One complete isolated object only. This is a replacement sowing sprite, not a sheet or icon collection.
